name: Gargoyle Head
concept: A fire trap mounted on a dungeon wall at a hero's chest height: a chunky stone gargoyle head bursting out of a square stone plaque, both in the same pale grey stone as the dungeon floor tiles. The plaque is a plain thick slab a little taller than wide with one broad clean chamfer. The head is big and blocky, about as wide as the barrel's lid, pushing forward from the plaque: a heavy brow ridge over two deep carved eye sockets, a broad blunt snout with two nostril holes, two short thick horns curling back from the brow, small pointed ears, and a wide open mouth gaping straight ahead as a real deep dark hole, framed by four stubby fangs. Broad planar facets and softly bevelled edges, no chips, no cracks, no moss. Friendly-menacing and chunky like the pack's own art, readable from the game's raised camera as something that spits fire.

provenance.quality_notes: Fire trap wall mount at KayKit dungeon scale: a horned gargoyle head on a 0.7 x 0.8 m plaque, 0.2 m thick, all in stone_light, its open mouth around the trap scene's glow (1.01 m high, 0.63 m out). Keeps the placeholder's measured bounds, so rooms hang it where they did and the muzzle stays put. No gameplay data.
